reviewed_primary_sources.use: All 15 wire declarations and field ordering retained. Corrected docs make authentication/Current separate. Unused private writer matches method deferred until the successor validator actually calls it.
Original exact-byte request digest contract, 32768-byte limit, request/schema/status binding and token/head epoch/counter consistency. No donor transport/coordinator moved.
Reuse the existing Refused/Unavailable checkpoint error, while leaving its real protected acknowledgement trait and caller unmodified.

Sha256Digest derives transparent Deserialize; that path does not call parse. Codec explicitly invokes parse for all digest-valued request/ACK fields, including optional proposal and retained request, without recomputing any opaque server token.
Actual canonical UUID type used by the synthetic wire fixture.

Fixed publisher/sequence request identity, exact prior token, full successor head, encoded request digest, monotonic ReadHead, legal Current→Dirty→Publishing→Current transitions and changed opaque token.
Seven-field writer binding equality copied as expressions into the shared proposal validator. No otherwise-unused method added to the wire module.

Actual original ObjectiveSenderWriterFence shape; owner binding and full lease/writer digest are retained in the requested and acknowledged proposal. This codec does not independently verify the underlying lease.

current_types.digest: Actual transparent Deserialize does not invoke Sha256Digest::parse; the codec explicitly validates every digest-bearing request and reply field, including optional proposal and retained request. parse requires exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal ASCII bytes.
current_types.agent_id: Existing AgentId validates lowercase RFC UUID shape/version/variant through its custom Deserialize.
current_types.anchor: Existing CognitiveRecoveryAnchor derives deny_unknown_fields and Eq, and explicitly says exact cut is not authentication or authority.
current_types.writer_fence: Existing ObjectiveSenderWriterFence contains the owner, full lease digest and seven binding fields; the codec retains them and does not create a lease.

behavior_review: Request IDs must be exactly 32 ASCII hex bytes before UTF-8 slicing; both halves must be nonzero. The malicious multibyte cross-boundary case is present.

Frames are limited to 32768 actual encoded bytes; empty/oversized reply rejection occurs before serde decoding. Trailing non-whitespace, duplicate and unknown fields are controlled by original serde struct checks.
Opaque peer tokens are returned unchanged. No local JSON/SQLite hash mints a token, grant or trusted Current.

Request schema/operation/shape, ACK schema/request ID/status/reason, token-head epoch/counter and exact-cut identity/profile/digests are checked. Refused stays Refused; Unknown/malformed becomes Unavailable.

Mutation validation checks exact full predecessor token and monotonic request sequence, derives complete successor and compares the entire returned head including retained exact request digest/command/predecessor.

Only Current→Dirty, Dirty→Publishing and Publishing→Current are supported. Prepare/commit verify owner, cut profile and the existing seven writer-binding fields; commit consumes the retained proposed cut. Counter overflow is rejected.
All three R2e2a controls remain byte-identical in R2e2b; four further controls are added. Independently computed all three frozen request SHA256 values match literal ACK fixture hashes.

Shared sequence/receipt/digest validators have actual multiple callers. No new Cargo dependency, lock edge, build include, production sender call, Windows private-state behavior or Agentd original_sender change appears in these diffs.
important_nonqualification: ReadHead decode_against is identity/monotonicity checking only. Its synthetic Fenced test intentionally permits a changed observation with an unchanged counter/token; no full state-transition or authenticated Current proof follows from that API.

The DTO structs are publicly constructible and deserializable. Any future trusted Current/admission constructor must be private and tied to an actual independently authenticated current peer, owner, lease/expiry/revocation/fence and exact cut; arbitrary Receipt→Current conversion is not accepted.
No actual transport, retained owner serialization, physical pool custody, cancellation-safe binder or production normal-entry caller is supplied by these protocol cohorts.

Native compile/test and original owning Memory/full-workspace gates have not run. The seven controls are executable proposals, not seven passing tests; no runtime-negative control is claimed from the absence of a prior API.
Actual formatted diffs must still satisfy per-cohort review limits. Hygiene is deferred until original required tests, and no tests are to be rerun after final fix/fmt.
